description:
Recent Wall Street analyst rating actions on a single stock, covering the
    trailing 12 months (newest first).

    `ratings` holds one row per analyst, their latest rating, newest first.
    Each row carries the analyst's name, expertUID and firm, the rating
    (Buy/Hold/Sell), the action (initiated/upgraded/downgraded/reiterated/
    maintained), recommendationDate and timestamp, the price target in its
    own currency (priceTarget, priceTargetCurrencyCode) and converted
    (convertedPriceTarget, convertedPriceTargetCurrencyCode), and the analyst's
    TipRanks credibility (numOfStars 0-5, rank, successRate as a fraction,
    excessReturn as the average return) plus the source article title/quote.

    The response is size-bounded, so a long list comes in pages: when rows are
    left out the result carries `nextOffset`; call again with that offset for
    the next page, until a result has no `nextOffset`. `totalRatings` is the
    full count. The source returns at most the 100 newest ratings; when it hit
    that limit the result carries `feedLimit`, and older ratings are not
    available from this tool.

    `counts` gives exact last30Days / last90Days / last12Months totals
    (analysts whose latest rating falls in the window, split buy/hold/sell) over
    every rating fetched, as of `asOf`; answer 'how many analysts rated X in the
    past month' from `counts`, which cover every page.

    For the aggregate consensus and average/best price target, use
    get_assets_data instead.

    Args:
        ticker: Stock ticker (e.g. 'NVDA', 'AAPL').
        offset: Index of the first rating to return in the newest-first list
                (default 0); pass the previous result's `nextOffset`.

    Returns: {ticker, asOf, totalRatings, counts, offset, ratings, and nextOffset
             when more remain}. recommendationDate is a 'MM/DD/YYYY' string;
             numOfStars is the analyst's 0-5 TipRanks star rating.
name: get_recent_analyst_ratings
